entities.summary: Dominez Burnett is an American former professional basketball player from Flint, Michigan. Burnett last played for Ironi Nahariya. In 2016, Burnett was named the Bevo Francis National Small College Basketball Player of the Year. Prior to that, in 2015, Burnett was named the NABC NAIA Division II Player of the Year, while playing for Davenport University.
